note: Hidden test/demo submodule of label_help. Installing it imports (config/install) the node type test_label_help_core_fields plus ~24 field_lh_* fields, each carrying third_party_settings.label_help.label_help_description. Baseline on this site is UNINSTALLED. Medium cases enable it and read the fixture back from the live site; hard cases require installing the fixture (reset uninstalls, verify checks the module is installed and the content type exists). All grounded in real shipped config (machine name test_label_help_core_fields, field_lh_boolean's help text).

evals.prompt: The label_help_test submodule installs a demonstration content type. What is that content type's machine name?
evals.expected_output: It installs the node type test_label_help_core_fields ('TEST Label Help Core Fields').

evals.prompt: What is the purpose of the label_help_test module, and is it meant for production sites?
evals.expected_output: It is a hidden Testing-package fixture for the Label Help module: it installs a content type with one field of nearly every core type (each with Label Help text) to demonstrate/test placement across widgets. Not for production.

evals.prompt: What naming prefix do the fields that label_help_test creates use, and roughly what do they cover?
evals.expected_output: All fields are named field_lh_* (e.g. field_lh_boolean, field_lh_string, field_lh_datetime, field_lh_image, field_lh_user_ref) and cover nearly every core field type so Label Help placement can be exercised on each widget.

evals.prompt: The label_help_test module is installed on this site. Inspect the running site and give the machine name of the content type it provides.
evals.expected_output: The content type is test_label_help_core_fields (loadable as a node type on the live site).

evals.prompt: With label_help_test installed on this site, inspect the live field configuration for the field_lh_boolean field on its content type and report the Label Help text stored on it.
must_contain_any: Label Help message for Boolean field
evals.expected_output: field.field.node.test_label_help_core_fields.field_lh_boolean has third_party_settings.label_help.label_help_description = 'Label Help message for Boolean field.'

evals.prompt: Install the label_help_test fixture on this site so the test_label_help_core_fields content type and its field_lh_* example fields exist.
evals.expected_output: label_help_test is installed (drush en label_help_test) and the node type test_label_help_core_fields exists on the site.

evals.prompt: I want the Label Help example content type, with all its sample fields already filled in with helper text, set up on my site so I can see how it looks.
evals.expected_output: Enabling the label_help_test module installs the test_label_help_core_fields content type and its field_lh_* fields (each pre-filled with Label Help text).
